existing.description: The MOE Teaching Scholarships/Award (Full-Term) sponsors Singaporean school leavers through a full-time undergraduate degree so that they can enter the Education Service as teachers. Applicants may be offered either an Education Merit Scholarship or Teaching Scholarship administered by the Public Service Commission, or a Teaching Award administered by MOE, and are considered for the full range. Scholars receive undergraduate tuition fees and other approved charges, a maintenance allowance, developmental programmes and approved student exchange, summer programmes and co-curricular activities, against a bond of four to six years depending on where they study.
eligibility: Singapore Citizen at the point of offer
A well-rounded individual with good academic and co-curricular activities (CCA) records
GCE A-Level, International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma, Polytechnic Diploma, NUS High School Diploma or equivalent
Possesses excellent interpersonal and communication skills
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be Singapore Citizens at the point of offer, well-rounded with good academic and co-curricular activities records, hold a GCE A-Level, International Baccalaureate Diploma, Polytechnic Diploma, NUS High School Diploma or equivalent, demonstrate strong leadership qualities, and possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills. The course of study should be relevant to a teaching subject.
benefits: Sponsorship of undergraduate tuition fees and other approved programmes
Return economy airfare if studying overseas
Approved student exchange programmes, summer programmes and CCAs
Possible Master's degree sponsorship if requirements are met
coverage: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Return economy airfare, if you are studying overseas
Approved student exchange programmes, summer programmes and CCAs
Possibility of sponsorship of a Master's degree (if requirements are met)
requirements: Study at a reputable local or overseas university, or the NTU-NIE Bachelor of Arts/Science (BABSc) programme
Choose a course relevant to a teaching subject, such as Art and Music, Humanities, Languages, Mathematics, Physical Education and Sports Science, Sciences or Social Sciences
All applicants are considered for the full range of MOE Teaching Scholarships and Award
Shortlisted applicants are invited for an interview and may be scheduled for other selection processes

application_method: Submit an online application form complete with the necessary supporting documents during the relevant window
Apply directly to MOE via the links published on the MOE application page
Candidates interested in the PSC Scholarship (Teaching Service) instead apply via the PSC Gateway Portal at https://www.psc.gov.sg/scholarships/undergraduate-scholarships/psc-scholarships
existing.selection_notes: MOE advises applying during the relevant window and not waiting until the end, because those who apply earlier and are shortlisted are scheduled for interviews and other selection processes sooner. Applicants can generally expect to hear back within four weeks of the close of the window, and if they have not heard within three weeks after an interview the application is still being actively considered.
existing.best_fit: Singapore Citizen school leavers with strong academic, co-curricular and leadership records who intend to teach in Singapore MOE schools and can apply inside the window for their specific qualification type.
existing.duration: Full-time undergraduate degree; bond of 4 years for local studies, 5 years for non-English speaking countries, 6 years for English speaking countries, plus a concurrent 3-year PGDE bond at NIE for those who take the Postgraduate Diploma in Education
existing.application_period: Per qualification type: International Baccalaureate and international or other qualifications open mid-October 2026; NUS High School Diploma opens early December 2026; Polytechnic Diploma opens early February 2027; Singapore-Cambridge GCE A Level opens at GCE A-Level results release and closes 19 March 2027
